name: sasu
description: SASU — open-source voice desktop agent for macOS

scripts.core:demo: uv run --project core python -m sasu_core --demo --port 8765 --token dev --dev
scripts.protocol:gen: uv run --project core python -m sasu_core.protocol > packages/protocol/schema.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sasu/desktop test && uv run --project core pytest -q core/tests
scripts.assets: uv run --with playwright --with pillow python apps/web/scripts/render-assets.py
